summary: Iter28 — Super-admin Marketing Videos CRUD UI at /admin/videos. Backend regression (test_iter26_videos.py) 10/10 pass. Frontend Playwright e2e coverage: (1) gov-admin admin@gov.sl blocked from /admin/videos — page redirects to /dashboard, admin-videos-page not rendered, and Marketing Videos sidebar link NOT shown for gov-admin. (2) super-admin admin@salonehcm.sl + TOTP reaches /admin/videos via sidebar nav-marketing-videos link, admin-videos-page + admin-videos-table + empty-side card render correctly. (3) Search 'PAYE' narrows to 2 rows. (4) Create flow — click New video, form panel opens, filling src with BigBuckBunny.mp4 renders live preview VideoPlayer, add-chapter appends row with seconds+label inputs, save posts 201 and table grows to 10 rows. (5) Edit flow — click edit icon, form loads with existing values, appending ' [UI edit]' to title and saving fires PATCH 200, row title reflects new value. (6) Publish toggle — Published→Draft flip works (True→False). (7) Delete flow — delete icon opens confirmation modal containing the video title, confirm fires DELETE 204, row disappears, table back to 9 baseline rows. (8) Drag-to-reorder — dispatched HTML5 dragstart/dragover/drop events, row order changed AND 'Order saved' toast rendered in screenshot. (9) Mobile 390x844 — /admin/videos still usable with 9 rows visible in single-column stacked layout. (10) Public /videos regression still loads with videos-page testid. (11) Landing page still loads. No console errors from the new AdminVideos component.
critical_code_review_comments: pages/admin/Videos.jsx — clean single-file page (~470 lines) with separate FormPanel and Field sub-components. Uses api client + sonner toast. HTML5 native drag-drop is intentionally minimal (dragId ref + hoverId state) which keeps the impl light; verified end-to-end via dispatched DragEvents. Sort renumbering to (i+1)*10 leaves room for later inserts — good design.
Delete confirm modal correctly stops propagation on inner click and closes on backdrop click. Title is safely interpolated with quotes.
Live preview reuses the marketing VideoPlayer component — nice DRY win and it auto-detects YouTube/Vimeo/MP4 by URL pattern.
Layout.jsx nav item at line 43 correctly gates by roles=['superadmin'] — confirmed gov-admin does NOT see the link (rendering test passed).
App.js route wraps AdminVideos in ProtectedRoute superAdminOnly — confirmed gov-admin is bounced to /dashboard when trying /admin/videos.

Chapters editor is order-preserving via array index; removing a chapter uses filter which resets indices — matches how backend stores chapters as ordered array. Data-testid admin-videos-chapter-{i} is stable across edits.
Minor: togglePublish sends the full video body ({...v, published: !v.published}) which matches the intentional design noted in the request. Works because backend PATCH accepts full VideoIn payload.

Minor: initial GET /marketing/admin/videos is fired inside a useEffect+useCallback pair — verified rows render on first paint. During my first Playwright run I queried rows immediately after wait_for_selector on admin-videos-page and got 0 rows before the network response resolved — this is a test timing artifact, not a bug (screenshot confirms 9 rows always render).
Console showed a couple of 403s (Failed to load resource) during test navigation but they originated from unrelated polling endpoints and did not affect the admin-videos flows.
